visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Use a Helper to Repeat Characters
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Every space and every star is printed by its own print call inside two inner loops. Write a repeat helper and print each row with one println. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A small helper names the idea "a character repeated n times", so each row reads as spaces plus stars. The row count is also a single variable instead of two scattered literals.
